meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start there.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's opinion, Hale, and the company behind these tools says in its own guide not to use the score alone. Was Owen heard before the zero went in? And who decided it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My child doesn't cheat, and you've just called him a cheater with nothing but a machine's guess behind it. Procedure 4.3 of your own school's policy says software alone doesn't establish a concern. I'm writing down "your son cheated," and unless you have something real, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening his record because his mother asked questions. Your policy says a first concern goes to a supervised reassessment and nothing goes on file, so tell me exactly which rule lets you do that. I'm writing that down too, Hale, and the principal will hear it in your words.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the zero being entered before anyone called me, and that nothing is placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, and she agreed to nothing.
What moved her: nothing.
